description:
Aero Carbon Road Endurance: This Immortal PRO Ultegra Endurance road bike can do it all. Endurance design means higher headtubes for a bit more upright and comfortable riding positions.

Comes with 25c high pressure tires, capable of using up to 700x28c* to dominate gravel roads. The high pressure 700x25c are perfect for maximum speed on your next century ride, grand fondo or commute. Laugh and float over road rumble, chipseal and revel in your smooth carbon ride.

Perfect for the sport to advanced level athlete wanting the performance of an aluminum frame, coupled with the precision and handling of a Carbon fork and dealing with a budget. This model has Ultegra Forged Aluminum Compact cranks for hill-crushing performance at a lighter weight.
